mapper.select: SELECT i.sheet_id AS sheetId, CASE WHEN r.mark REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CASE WHEN (i.range_min IS NOT NULL AND CAST(r.mark AS DECIMAL(10,3)) < i.range_min) OR (i.range_max IS NOT NULL AND CAST(r.mark AS DECIMAL(10,3)) > i.range_max) THEN '#OUT' ELSE '#OK' END ELSE r.mark END AS mark, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM condition_equip_check_result r JOIN condition_equip_check_item i ON i.item_id = r.item_id WHERE r.ym = #{ym} GROUP BY 1, 2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO condition_equip_check_sheet (title, equip_name, model_no, legend_json, cycle_json, sign_json, footer_note, sort_order, use_yn, reg_user_id, reg_user_name, upd_user_id, upd_user_name) VALUES (#{title}, #{equipName}, #{modelNo}, #{legendJson}, #{cycleJson}, #{signJson}, #{footerNote}, #{sortOrder}, #{useYn}, #{regUserId}, #{regUserName}, #{regUserId}, #{regUserName})
mapper.select: SELECT i.* FROM condition_equip_check_item i WHERE i.sheet_id = #{sheetId} AND (i.use_yn = 'Y' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_equip_check_result r WHERE r.item_id = i.item_id AND r.ym = #{ym}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_equip_check_note n WHERE n.item_id = i.item_id AND n.ym = #{ym})) ORDER BY i.seq, i.item_id
SELECT * FROM condition_equip_check_item WHERE sheet_id = #{sheetId} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY seq, item_id

SELECT IFNULL(MAX(seq), 0) FROM condition_equip_check_item WHERE sheet_id = #{sheetId}
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM condition_equip_check_result WHERE item_id = #{itemId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM condition_equip_check_note WHERE item_id = #{itemId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM condition_equip_check_item WHERE sheet_id = #{sheetId} AND use_yn = 'Y' AND cycle = #{cycle}

mapper.update: UPDATE condition_equip_check_item SET seq = #{seq} WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
